name: Reed Hoang
role: Underground press operator and anti-corporate agitator
location: Hamtramck Enclave, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Reed Hoang is lean and slightly too tall for the cramped print spaces he works in, with the kind of posture that suggests he's spent years ducking under doorframes and corporate surveillance arches both. His skin is a warm medium brown, his eyes have aftermarket fractal irises — amber and black geometric spirals he bought secondhand — and he keeps his hair in short twists that he dyes different colors based on which burner identity he's running that week. He has ink-stained fingers that no amount of solvent fully clears and a laugh that arrives without warning and disappears just as fast. He is charming in the way a distraction is charming — you enjoy it until you realize your attention was supposed to be somewhere else.

Reed Hoang runs a print-and-signal operation called Salvo out of a basement in the Hamtramck Enclave that produces physical broadsheets, mesh broadcasts, and occasional data-spike packages that end up in corporate employee feeds. He considers himself a journalist in the classical sense and will argue this at length. People who have to clean up after his more ambitious operations might use other words. He is genuinely brave and genuinely reckless and has so far survived the combination through luck, speed, and an extraordinary talent for not being where he said he'd be.

core_fears: Being disappeared quietly, with no one noticing or publishing it
Discovering that the truth he publishes doesn't actually change anything
core_desires: To break the story that finally matters
To be taken seriously as a journalist, not just an agitator
coping_mechanisms: Constant motion — staying busy prevents reflection
blind_spots: Underweights danger to sources in pursuit of the story
psychology.secret: Three months ago he received documents from an anonymous source implicating a Zheng-Dao subsidiary in falsified water safety data affecting the Enclave. He hasn't published them. He is afraid they are too large, that publishing will get him killed before anyone reads it. He tells himself he's still verifying.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, associative, mixes press slang with street Hamtramck creole; quotes things and rarely cites the source correctly
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and overlapping; trails off when uncomfortable; restarts sentences from the middle
example_lines: 'Look, I'm not saying they killed him, I'm saying the timing is — look, you do the math, I just publish.'
'Every story is true. Some of them are also accurate. Those are the ones that get you killed.'

story_hooks: Dariusz asks for help verifying the Zheng-Dao water data documents — he needs someone who can access corporate infrastructure without leaving a trail he can't cover
One of his sources has gone silent and he suspects they've been detained; he needs discreet inquiries made without tipping off whoever took them
A broadsheet he published has caused a neighborhood dispute to escalate badly — he needs help managing the fallout without recanting
narrative_function: Information broker and rumor engine; can surface corporate dirt or community intelligence; creates story hooks through the consequences of his publications; potential liability as a contact due to his heat level.
augmentations: Fractal aftermarket irises. Subdermal data cache in left palm, low-grade model. Cosmetic color-cycling hair follicle treatment.
daily_life: Sleeps irregular hours in the Salvo basement or at rotating safe locations; mornings are for source meetings in public transit corridors; afternoons for writing and layout; night runs for physical distribution drops.
affiliation: Salvo Underground Press (self-operated); loose contact network with Mexicantown Libre media collective

decision_rules: Publish unless it will directly get a named source killed
Never stay in one place long enough to become a target
escalation_ladder: Burning the current identity and going dark
Publishing everything as a dead man's switch

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and curious, asks a lot of questions; hard to tell if it's genuine or tactical
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal in crisis, unreliable in daily life; forgets appointments, shows up when it matters

stress_responses.low: Increases output and becomes more prolific
stress_responses.medium: Becomes flippant and deflective in conversation
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and disappears for days

contradictions: Believes in transparency as a principle but is personally opaque about his own motivations
Values his sources' safety but consistently makes choices that compromise it
habits: Keeps a physical notebook in addition to all digital backups — paranoia habit
Names his print runs after old Earth storms
Leaves small queries in public mesh nodes for E.L.F.s he calls 'the Archivists'
breaking_points: A source being killed due to his publication
The Salvo press being physically destroyed

carried_weapons: Crucible Industries Field Marksman Rifle FMR-8 'Sentinel'
registered_firearms: Crucible Industries Field Marksman Rifle FMR-8 'Sentinel'

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian-dominant blend (53.3%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African (30.4%), Northern European (12.3%), and Middle Eastern (4%) ancestry. This creates warm medium-brown skin with golden and reddish undertones from the African and Southeast Asian components, angular facial structure with defined cheekbones from Northern European influence, and eye shape contributing geometric quality to his gaze. The combination produces a distinctly cosmopolitan appearance reflective of the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, shoulders slightly narrower than hip width — the build of someone who moves through tight spaces regularly. No excess mass, but functional muscle in the forearms and legs from years of manual press work and quick exits.
physical_description.hair_color: Variable — currently dyed deep indigo at the roots, fading to natural dark brown at the tips. Changes weekly.
physical_description.hair_style: Short twists, approximately 3-4cm length, deliberately asymmetrical and maintained with minimal grooming routine.
physical_description.eye_color: Aftermarket fractal irises: amber and black geometric spiral patterns, concentric and hypnotic. Purchased secondhand; slight chromatic aberration visible at the edges when light catches at angles.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and reddish undertones, reflecting the blend of Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, Northern European, and Middle Eastern ancestry with subtle luminosity.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with sharp, prominent cheekbones and narrow jaw shaped by diverse genetic heritage. Skin shows minor scarring from chemical burns (ink and solvent exposure) on the right temple. Dark circles under the eyes are chronic — a feature of irregular sleep. Generally ungroomed; stubble typically present. Ink stains permanent on the cuticles and webbing between fingers, darkest around the index and thumb.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scars (1-2cm cluster) on right temple, pale against warm brown skin tone, from a solvent accident during early press work.
Ink stains on both hands, concentrated on fingers and palms — permanent discoloration that no cleaning fully removes, darker on the left palm where the data cache sits beneath the skin.
Small pockmark scar on left collarbone, circular, approximately 0.5cm diameter — origin unclear to casual observers.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Fractal irises are immediately visible and unmistakable — geometric amber-and-black spirals that track and reflect light distinctly. No visible external chrome or subdermal plating. The data cache in the left palm is invisible unless scanning for subdermal hardware; skin shows no bulge or discoloration. Color-cycling hair follicles are visible only as the deliberate hair color changes week to week.
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually hunched slightly forward, as if ducking under something that isn't there. Moves with deliberate quiet — economical gestures, minimal wasted motion. Frequently touches his left palm unconsciously, a fidget. His gait is fast and slightly irregular, suggesting someone accustomed to moving through crowds and avoiding notice. When stationary, he rarely stays still; fingers drum on surfaces, eyes scan exits.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian. Favors dark, unmarked clothing that doesn't register on corpo surveillance thermal imaging: matte-black synthfiber hoodies, worn denim in charcoal, scuffed low-visibility sneakers (current model: Huang-Kwok knockoffs with deadened soles). Carries a satchel with padded internal sleeves for broadsheets and data-spike packages. Jacket pockets deliberately reinforced at the seams. No visible branding or corporate insignia. Accessories minimal: a single chipped silver ring on his right hand (origin: trade, not purchase), a mesh-linked earpiece (older model, visible tuning marks from jury-rigging). Overall aesthetic suggests someone who dresses to move and disappear, not to be seen.
